pride_data.title: Structural basis of the human transcriptional Mediator complex modulated by its dissociable Kinase module
pride_data.projectDescription: The Mediator complex consists of a Core and a dissociable Kinase module. This project is to understand the binding mode between the Core and Kinase module. Both Mediator complex and its Kinase module were individually crosslinked and analyzed by XL-MS.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: The human Mediator complex was isolated directly from H293 cells through a Flag-tagged CDK8. The eluted complex was further purified by glycerol gradient centrifugation. The Mediator-containing fractions were combined and subjected to dialysis and concentration. The recombinant Kinase module was expressed and purified from insect cells. The purified kinase module was further purified by glycerol gradient centrifugation and subjected to dialysis and concentration. Both samples were crosslinked by DSBU and subjected to XL-MS analysis.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: MeroX was utilized with default setting with minor edits described in the method section. Prioritization of K-K pair were done when K miscleavages present and localization score ties.
